name: investment-case-writer
description: Writes the quarterly or annual case for continued investment in an innovation program (what was learned, what was stopped and why, the portfolio against the target mix, and what the next round costs), part of the Innovation Pack by 90n. Use this whenever the user says "run investment-case-writer", "write the innovation budget case", "justify the program to the partners", "quarterly innovation review", "what did the program deliver this year", or when budget season arrives and the program needs to earn its next round. Use it even for "the CFO is asking what innovation is for".
